pageTitle: North Carolina Lottery Results and Winning Numbers

items.question: What Are the Requirements to Buy Lottery Tickets in North Carolina?
items.answer: Your North Carolina lottery scratch and draw tickets are only available in-store. Players must be at least 18. A North Carolina lottery app allows you to purchase tickets, check North Carolina lottery results, and get info on North Carolina lottery codes. The app is also a North Carolina lottery ticket scanner for checking your draw or scratch tickets.

items.question: What Lottery Games Can You Play in North Carolina?
items.answer:
You can play familiar nationwide games, such as Mega Millions and Powerball. North Carolina Lottery Lucky for Life is also a popular choice. Other titles include: 

 

Carolina Cash 5 – Choose five numbers from 1-43.

Carolina Pick 4 – Choose four numbers to match the draw in the correct order.

Carolina Pick 3 – Choose three numbers to match the draw in the correct order.

Where and How Do I Claim Winnings from the North Carolina Lottery?

 

When the North Carolina lottery results fall in your favor and you need to claim your prize, the size of the prize determines your options. Prizes over $599 can be claimed at retail outlets,  lottery headquarters, any lottery claim center, or through the mail.  Prizes from $600 and above can be claimed at the claim centers and lottery headquarters.

items.question: How Do You Play and Win in the North Carolina Lottery?
items.answer: Your numbers need to match the North Carolina Lottery numbers. For instance, Carolina Cash 5 requires a player to pick numbers between 1-43. The objective is to choose five numbers that will appear in the draw. Smaller prizes can be won with fewer matched North Carolina Lottery winning numbers.

items.question: What Are the Odds of Winning the North Carolina Lottery?
items.answer:
Odds for winning the North Carolina lottery Mega Millions are 1 in 302 million. For the North Carolina Lottery Powerball jackpot it is 1 in 175 million. Other odds are as follows:

 

Lucky for Life: 1 in 31 million

Carolina Cash 5: 1 in 84,000

Carolina Pick 4: 1 in 10,000

Carolina Pick 3: 1 in 1000

items.question: What’s the Biggest North Carolina Lottery Win?
items.answer: North Carolina Lottery winners pocket about $4 million in prizes every day. In 2019, $344.6 million of that money went to Charles Jackson Jr.

items.question: When Is the North Carolina Lottery Results Draw?
items.answer:
The results of the North Carolina lottery take place at the following approximate times:

 

Mega Millions: Tuesdays and Fridays at 11 pm.

Powerball: Wednesdays and Saturdays at 11 pm

Lucky for Life: Mondays and Thursdays 10:35 pm

Carolina Cash 5: Daily at 11:20

Carolina Pick 4 and Pick 3: Daily at 3 pm and 11:22 pm

items.question: What Is the North Carolina Lottery Second Chance?
items.answer: You can enter non-winning scratch cards for more chances to win. Scratch tickets can be entered into North Carolina Lottery Second Chance draws for prizes up to $100 000.

items.question: Do I Have to Pay Tax on North Carolina Lottery Winnings?
items.answer: North Carolina lottery winners will pay state tax on winnings starting at $600. Up to $5000, a state tax of 5.499% will be withheld. Over $5000, 5.499% state tax and 24% federal tax is payable.
